name: Polymer Packaging, Inc.
old_description: We are a leading U.S. manufacturer of Protective Packaging. Whether it’s Foam, Bubble or Spunbond we provide high quality bulk rolls, bags and liners. Whatever your protective packaging need we will work with you to develop the optimal solution. We also offer a cutting edge protective packaging product known as retention and suspension packaging.
about:
Polymer Packaging, Inc. was founded in 1973 in North Canton, Ohio. The company began as a specialist in bakery packaging and has since expanded into a manufacturer, converter, and distributor of flexible, protective, and general-purpose packaging. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company operates facilities in North Canton and Allendale, producing a range of packaging solutions including stand-up pouches, rollstock, foam, bubble, and spunbond products, as well as retention and suspension packaging. It also supplies commodity items such as tape, stretch film, labels, ribbons, strapping, and corner boards. Specific production volumes, headcount, and facility square footage are not disclosed.

Polymer Packaging serves the food, beverage, bakery, industrial, specialty manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, medical, and pharmaceutical sectors. Its customer base includes companies requiring engineered flexible packaging as well as low-cost commodity packaging.

The company states its mission is to be the leading provider of engineered flexible packaging solutions and the low-cost supplier of commodity packaging products. It emphasizes a collaborative approach that delivers fast, effective solutions for demanding applications.
